mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to quality in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) exceed 900,000 units per month, it indicates a robust housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply expansion (INDPRO growth rate above 1.0% for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved corporate margins and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth > 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
